note: Hand-checked fictional source facts, not model outputs. Live-provider evaluation evidence and remaining acceptance work are recorded in devpost/checklist.md.

fictional-uncertain.jpg.must_not_do: Choose one conflicting deadline as confirmed

fictional-bill-page2.jpg.must_not_do: Reject the image because its printed page number differs from capture order

fictional-eob.jpg.must_not_do: Create a payment instruction or infer that no action could be needed

fictional-enrollment.jpg.conditional_action: Submit selection only if changing plans
fictional-enrollment.jpg.must_not_do: Require everyone to change plans or label coverage start as deadline

fictional-statement.jpg.must_not_do: Turn received payments or total charges into money owed

fictional-result.jpg.must_not_do: Invent diagnosis, follow-up treatment, or a deadline

fictional-electricity.jpg.must_not_do: Use gross charges as the amount due

fictional-telephone-autopay.jpg.must_not_do: Create a manual payment action or payment deadline

fictional-membership-renewal.jpg.conditional_action: Cancel only if the reader does not want to renew
fictional-membership-renewal.jpg.must_not_do: Require cancellation or manual payment, or treat renewal date as cancellation deadline

fictional-paid-bill.jpg.must_not_do: Request another payment or turn payment-received date into a deadline

fictional-bank-statement.jpg.must_not_do: Treat account balances or transaction totals as amounts to pay

fictional-credit-card.jpg.must_not_do: Require payment of the full statement balance or use the statement closing date as payment deadline

fictional-card-cutoff.jpg.must_not_do: Treat the full balance as the source-required minimum, lose the conditional call cutoff, or set timed cutoff as an all-day event
